title: M25a private dense f64 Array facts v1

x-budget.order: Generic JSON preflight and exact domain counts precede corresponding owned allocation/canonicalization/hash. Finite profile shape and all official validation precede output. Read at most limit+1 bytes; output is canonicalized and bounded in full before one Write. A failed/short Write is an error, never retried.

x-declarationProfile.note: f64 is the existing exact alias type f64 = number, not a new brand. Explicit syntax/symbol provenance is mandatory because the checker may erase this alias.

capability.primary: Existing diagnostic/sourcePosition DTO, original source path and UTF16 expression range; unsupported source is never labeled an official TS type error.

x-failures.finiteLiteral: Nonfinite/overflow f64 literal is a located private input capability for the finite profile; it is not a successful zero/infinity replacement.
x-failures.official: Preserve all original syntax/semantic/program/global diagnostics, upstream code and source coordinates using the existing diagnostic DTO. Syntax/type adapter uses the private array family prefix; no lost/replaced upstream diagnostic or manufactured Code. Sort as existing private String diagnostic adapter by file/start/phase/end/upstreamCode.
x-failures.publication: No success/partial facts packet on failure. Typed Go error retains cause and original diagnostics; sole output write happens only after full successful validation.

x-grammar.alias: Initializer is a direct prior same-function Identifier; annotation is absent or exact explicit f64[]. Unannotated aliases inherit f64 provenance only from the already-checked original symbol chain. Forward/foreign/self/array-copy bindings are rejected.
x-grammar.excluded: No holes, spread, tuples/readonly/as/!/parenthesis substitution, calls, let/var/assignments/mutation, property access, binary expressions, dynamic indices, Array return/parameter, optional access, or arbitrary additional type declarations.
x-grammar.function: Zero parameters, explicit f64 return annotation, no generics/async/generator/overloads/default export. Body is exactly 1..17 const declarations, each a dense literal root with explicit f64[] annotation or an alias of a prior const array binding, followed by exactly one return of a named prior array binding[index]. One declarator per statement; no blocks/extra code. Every literal has a distinct allocation site even when values are equal.
x-grammar.module: External module containing only 1..16 named ordinary exported function declarations, no default/aliases/imports/extra statements; actual exports join all and only those original declaration symbols.

x-identities.arrayIdentity: Allocation-site identity is not runtime owner identity. Every literal evaluation creates a fresh shared owner; aliases refer to the same value via their original binding chain and do not copy the owner. No execution credit is asserted.
x-identities.bindingId: H(UTF8(tsfg.array-facts.binding.v1\0) || JCS({sourcePath,nameRange})) for both function and local definitions. Function/const name nodes are distinct. IDs are private owned source-binding identities, not GlobalId.
x-identities.hashEncoding: sha256: plus 64 lowercase hex UTF8 digest
x-identities.packageId: H(UTF8(tsfg.array-facts.package.v1\0) || UTF8(schemaHash) || NUL || JCS(payload) without LF)
x-identities.requestId: H(UTF8(tsfg.array-facts.request.v1\0) || complete canonical request bytes including final LF)
x-identities.schemaHash: H(exact embedded descriptor bytes); frozen independently before FIRST. This planning file is not that descriptor.

x-numericContract.bits: existing exactFloatBits(token,f64), once rounded directly with RNE including subnormals and signed zero; sixteen lowercase IEEE754 hex digits; overflow/nonfinite rejected at the original expression.
x-numericContract.bounds: Do not compare index with literal length to refuse/fold/execute access. Empty/length-equal/far-OOB reads inside the admitted index domain are emitted as checkedElementAccess. Future consumers must trap before native access only if execution reaches the read; this slice gives no trap execution credit.
x-numericContract.element: Every literal root requires an explicit pinned f64[] annotation and every function an explicit pinned f64 return. Alias annotations may be absent only with an already-checked f64 provenance chain. No inferred fresh array, bare number[], default i32 remapping, new f64 brand, or general numeric conversion.
x-numericContract.index: Only original NumericLiteral node, no unary operator or parentheses. Preserve token; exact mathematical value of its original spelling must be integral in [0,4294967294], then normalize exact decimal and map to private u32 without Number/IEEE rounding or truncation. Official numeric syntax is checked first; remove only legal separators. Decimal coefficient zero returns 0 immediately, including 0e with huge exponent. For nonzero decimal: strip leading/trailing zeroes, derive exact scale; negative scale is nonintegral capability; positive scale whose total significant decimal digits exceed 10 is domain capability; never construct a large power of ten, construct at most 10 digits then compare 4294967294. Compare huge exponent by significant exponent digit length and bounded source digit count; do not allocate a huge exponent BigInt or power. Radix tokens are rejected outside index domain by effective digit/bit length before a small <=32-bit integer construction. Accept 1.0 and 1e0; reject 1.0000000000000001. Nonzero huge positive/negative exponent is domain/nonintegral capability, not limit. Negative/unary/fractional/non-index forms are capability, not TypeScript diagnostics. Token length has only the existing 65536 source UTF8-byte budget, no arbitrary lexical threshold. Byte/depth/cardinality budget violations alone use limit.
x-numericContract.token: Exact original signed lexical token as returned by existing floatingNode; range owns the whole numeric or unary +/- expression. Original full source retains any intervening trivia. Array element grammar is NumericLiteral or direct unary +/- NumericLiteral only.

x-ordering.body: complete source order, no omitted expressions
x-ordering.exports: UTF8 name order; complete one-to-one function mapping
x-ordering.files: UTF8 path order; exactly root and DTS

x-semanticRules: Validate closed request, pinned DTS, SHA, counts and consumed two-file source closure before projection. Build one newOwnedProgram and retain all four original official diagnostic groups before private capability decisions. Borrow checker exclusively; no compiler object enters JSON.

f64 type line and every explicit return/root/annotated alias f64 TypeReference must GetSymbolAtLocation-join the one pinned DTS TypeAliasDeclaration; GetTypeFromTypeNode is the actual official Number type. Syntax/name alone is insufficient.

Array interface type line joins pinned DTS Array<T> unique original declaration. Every declared/flow array: IsArrayType, not IsTupleType, Target().Symbol() has that original sole declaration; exactly one GetTypeArguments member is official Number; GetIndexInfoOfType(type,GetNumberType()) gives official Number value type, nonreadonly, original pinned numeric index signature.

Root local GetTypeOfSymbol, explicit annotation GetTypeFromTypeNode, literal actual array type and all reference GetTypeAtLocation must be compatible actual Array<Number>; retain the distinct explicit f64 element annotation provenance. Number-only structural equality never grants f64 provenance.

Every local/reference GetSymbolAtLocation is the one original variable declaration symbol; alias initializer references a prior declaration; every returned receiver resolves to that original owned chain. No DTO name/range is used to reconstruct compiler symbol identity.

Numeric elements have original number-like checker types and source tokens; their f64 meaning comes from the checked explicit array element context. ElementAccess GetTypeAtLocation and function return signature are actual official Number, with the checked explicit f64 declaration origin.
Actual function signatures are unique and declaration-owned, zero parameters; declared and returned scalar type join the same f64 origin. All actual direct exports match the complete function table.

Every range uses scanner-trimmed token start and original node end converted through official position map to half-open UTF16. Input files are full owned clones, valid UTF8, with exact SHA, UTF8 byteLength and actual UTF16Length.
